messages:
Maya Patel: Heads up — Crestline (acct: CRES-001) shows a ~62% drop in active token usage WoW. Top affected routes: /generate-chat and /embeddings-batch. Saw procurement paused note in ticket #4573. They also replaced their Head of Data last week (Aisha -> Tom).

Ethan Chen: yikes. do we have seats vs tokens broken down? any change in integration? timeline for contract renewal?

Logan Kim: I pulled infra metrics — 41% fewer unique API keys called last 7 days, median latency unchanged. No obvious errors. Their last onboarding workshop was 2025-12-10 per OnboardingBot.

OnboardingBot: Workshop logged: Crestline enablement — 2025-12-10 — attendees: Aisha Patel, Dev Team. Next scheduled: none.

Priya Rao: Competitor flag — rep mentioned a 6-week pilot with Aperture.ai for summarization. They benchmarked cost/latency. Need to surface friction + ROI. @Maya can you confirm pilot scope?

Maya Patel: Confirmed — Aperture pilot covers summarization + internal search. They ran a small eval and saw faster latencies but lower factuality. Procurement paused due to pricing comparison.

Ethan Chen: action items: 1) quick health call with Tom + procurement 2) offer a 2-week performance trial with our low-latency config + cost modeling 3) schedule tech deep-dive. who's in?

Logan Kim: I can run a perf config + cost delta. need sample p95 sequence length and typical batch size. Maya — can you grab a representative prompt set?

Maya Patel: I'll ask Tom for 10 sample transcripts and their SLA on acceptable latency. pinging @Tom Mercer in thread.

Tom Mercer: hey team — yes, I stepped in last week. we care about summarization speed — typical outputs 300–700 tokens. budget is tighter this quarter. open to a trial if we get clear cost controls.

Priya Rao: propose playbook: (a) 30-min procurement call to unblock pricing concerns, (b) 60-min tech workshop focused on hallucination mitigations + prompt templates, (c) 2-week limited trial with a cost cap and telemetry access so procurement can compare apples-to-apples. I'll draft calendar invites and a measurement plan.

Ethan Chen: schedule procurement call this week. @Maya can you set times? also mark renewal risk = medium-high and flag AE for escalation.

Maya Patel: setting up Doodle now. tagging Jordan Alvarez (AE). attaching a short one-pager on our summarization perf + an internal benchmark: '15% faster at 40% lower ops cost' from a similar customer.

Logan Kim: I'll prepare a cost model by EOD tomorrow, including quantization and batching scenarios and a conservative estimate for token usage during trial.

Priya Rao: I'll draft the workshop doc + pre-reads. plan to include prompt templates and telemetry dashboard access. will share link here when ready.

Ethan Chen: thanks team. primary goal: convert 'procurement pause' -> 'trial' within 7 days. keep all notes and customer responses here so AE can pick up the threads.
